reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "We have changed the default value of `Certificate.Spec.RevisionHistoryLimit` from `nil` to `1`. > 📖 Read Release 1.18 notes for more information.", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Certificates without revisionHistoryLimit now keep only 1 revision, and all stale CertificateRequest resources are garbage collected on upgrade to 1.18.
consequence.remediation: Explicitly set revisionHistoryLimit on Certificate resources if more CertificateRequest history must be retained.

proposed.statement: The default of Certificate spec.revisionHistoryLimit changed from nil to 1, so stale CertificateRequests are garbage collected on upgrade unless the field is set explicitly.
